programs.explicit_statement:
∀ (n : Nat) (state : Joins.State) (delta : Joins.Count) (flag : Bool) (v : LeanGo.Validate.Value),
  LeanGo.Validated.prog.run n "Joins.update"
        [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode state, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode delta, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode flag] =
      some v →
    v = LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Joins.update state delta flag)

    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode
        { count := { value := 0 }, nested := { count := { value := 1 } }, enabled := { value := false },
          raw := 2781043260 },

        { count := { value := 0 }, nested := { count := { value := 1 } }, enabled := { value := false },
          raw := 2781043260 }
